title: Roanoke, VA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Roanoke, VA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Roanoke is a city in VA with a population of 100,000. Star City of the Blue Ridge with the Roanoke Star, the Taubman Museum, and mountain access. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
